The '''13th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1955 in film|1955]] films, were held on February 23, 1956.

==Winners==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Motion Picture - Drama]]===
''' ''[[East of Eden (film)|East of Eden]] directed by [[Elia Kazan]]'''''
<ref>{{Cite web |title=Best Motion Picture Drama |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1955 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111811/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1955 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |access-date=2024-08-28}}</ref>

''' ''[[Guys and Dolls (film)|Guys and Dolls]] directed by [[Joseph L. Mankiewicz]]'''''
<ref>{{Cite web |title=Best Motion Picture Comedy or Musical |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1955 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111811/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1955 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |access-date=2024-08-28}}</ref>
